entities.summary: Kelly Brazier is a New Zealand rugby union coach and former player. She has played flyhalf, centre and fullback for the Black Ferns, New Zealand's women's national rugby team, and has competed at four Rugby World Cups in 2010, 2014, 2017 and 2025. She has represented Otago, Canterbury and the Bay of Plenty in the Farah Palmer Cup.
